notes: This table estimates Codex/ChatGPT plan-equivalent usage, not the temporary API/purchased-credit promotional bill.

GPT-5.6 Sol keeps the original subscription/quota budget basis: $5/M input, $0.50/M cached input, $30/M output. OpenAI states included plan usage, 5-hour/week limits and legacy rates are unchanged by the temporary Sol promotion.
Codex does not charge cache writes, so cache_write is zero in this plan-equivalent table.
Fast mode in Codex/Work uses 2.5x the Standard GPT-5.6 rate; priority and fast service_tier values both map to Fast.
Long context (>272K input tokens) applies 2x input/cached-input and 1.5x output before the Fast multiplier.
Terra and Luna retain their current reduced Codex usage basis because OpenAI explicitly reduced their Codex credit consumption on 2026-07-30.
